title: Red Hat Security Advisory: jackson-annotations, jackson-core, jackson-databind, jackson-jaxrs-providers, and…
description: Two denial of service vulnerabilities have been identified in the jackson-databind component of the Jackson Data Processor used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.4 Update Services for SAP Solutions. The first (CVE-2026-68497) involves CPU exhaustion via unbounded numeric parsing, and the second (CVE-2026-91777) involves denial of service through quadratic forward-reference completion. These issues could allow an attacker to cause resource exhaustion leading to service disruption.
